questions.stem: Auditors must see who downloaded objects from one sensitive Amazon S3 bucket. The account's trail logs only management events, and the account has hundreds of other busy buckets. The company wants to capture the needed activity while keeping CloudTrail costs as low as possible. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

choices.text: Enable data events on the trail with advanced event selectors that match only that bucket and the GetObject operation.
Enable data events on the trail for all S3 buckets in the account.
Keep the current trail, because management events already record GetObject calls on objects.
Enable CloudTrail Insights on the trail so that unusual download activity is recorded.

questions.stem: A security team wants records of every rejected connection attempt to the network interfaces in one subnet, stored in Amazon S3 for later queries. The records should be aggregated at the shortest interval that VPC Flow Logs supports. Accepted traffic should not be recorded. Which actions should the team take? (Choose TWO.)

choices.text: Create a flow log for the subnet that captures rejected traffic and publishes to Amazon S3.
Set the flow log's maximum aggregation interval to 1 minute.
Set the flow log's maximum aggregation interval to 30 seconds.
Create a flow log that captures all traffic and publishes directly to Amazon OpenSearch Service.
Keep the default maximum aggregation interval, which is the shortest interval available.

questions.stem: During a security review, a company finds that it has no record of the HTTP requests that reached its Application Load Balancer, and no central copy of the application log files that are written to local disks on its Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants both kinds of logs collected with managed features. Which actions should the company take? (Choose TWO.)

choices.text: Enable access logs on the Application Load Balancer and specify an Amazon S3 bucket for them.
Install the CloudWatch agent on the instances and configure it to send the application log files to CloudWatch Logs.
Find the existing access logs in the load balancer's console, because access logs are always on.
Enable VPC Flow Logs, which record the HTTP request paths that reach the load balancer.
Enable CloudTrail management events, which copy the application log files from the instances.
